author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices the five-finger home, zigzag and downhill patterns, counting four, a mountain-shaped song and singing while playing, together.

classes.title: Base camp: thumb on C
classes.goal: Hear the song and rest one finger on each of the five home keys.

mathTarget.parentLine: Using the two black keys to find where the hand lives

classes.parentPrompt: Point to the two black keys, then help your child rest the thumb on C.
classes.childAction: Find the two black keys, put your thumb on C.
classes.bridge: C is base camp, left of the two black keys; five fingers climb from there.

games.caption: One finger, one key
games.parentCue: Say the finger numbers together, one to five

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding the five-finger home on the keys.

classes.title: Climbing over rocks
classes.goal: Play the first line, with its zigzag around E, one finger per key.

mathTarget.parentLine: Stepping away from one key and back to it

classes.parentPrompt: You play the low G pickup first; then say the finger numbers with your child.
classes.childAction: After the grown-up's low G, climb: 1, 3, 3, 2, 3, 4, 3.
classes.bridge: The bear climbs over rocks: a step down, a step up, back to E.

intro.caption: Climbing over rocks
intro.parentCue: You play the low G; your child starts on C

games.caption: Over the rocks to E
games.parentCue: Say the finger numbers aloud, slowly

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: a zigzag pattern with different fingers.

classes.title: Down the other side
classes.goal: Play the last line, walking down from finger 5 all the way to the thumb.

mathTarget.parentLine: Counting down in order: five, four, three, two, one

classes.parentPrompt: You play the high A at the top; then count down five to one together.
classes.childAction: After the grown-up's A, walk down: 5, 4, 3, 2, 1.
classes.bridge: Over the top, then down the mountain, one step to the left at a time.

intro.caption: Down the other side
intro.parentCue: You play the top A; count down together

games.caption: Five, four, three, two, one
games.parentCue: Count down out loud with each key

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: walking down the keys in order.

classes.title: Three climbs, then the view
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly: the same words three times, then the ending.

mathTarget.concept: Form: three times, then an answer
mathTarget.parentLine: One line sung three times, then a new line to finish

classes.parentPrompt: Hold up a finger for each 'bear went over' line; on the last, shade your eyes.
classes.childAction: Count the bear lines: one, two, three, then look out!
classes.bridge: Three climbs up the mountain, then over the top and down to C.

intro.caption: Three climbs, then the view
intro.parentCue: hold up a finger for each climb

games.caption: Tap the beat: the first line
games.parentCue: Play the blue keys; your child taps the beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: counting the parts of a song.

classes.title: Four Ds in a row
classes.goal: Practise the second line slowly, with its four Ds in a row.

mathTarget.parentLine: Counting each D once, and the last number tells how many

classes.parentPrompt: Count the Ds aloud with your child: one, two, three, four, then go on.
classes.childAction: Finger 2 plays D four times; count them, then play on.
classes.bridge: Finger 2 knocks on D four times, then steps down and back up.

intro.caption: Watch slowly
intro.parentCue: Hold up four fingers before the Ds

games.caption: D, D, D, D, and on
games.parentCue: Count one, two, three, four on the Ds

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: counting four notes in a row.

classes.title: Big bear steps: one, two
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly while feeling two big bear steps each bar.

mathTarget.parentLine: Each bar has two big steps: one, two

classes.parentPrompt: Stomp your feet gently with your child on each big step: one, two.
classes.childAction: Play slowly and stomp two big bear steps each bar.
classes.bridge: The bear's big steps are slow and heavy: one, two, one, two.

games.caption: Tap the big slow steps
games.parentCue: Say 'one, two' on the big steps

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: feeling two big beats in a bar.

classes.title: Bear on the mountaintop
classes.goal: Move the hand to a higher C and play the song with the same fingers.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same song and fingers, moved to a higher home

classes.parentPrompt: Help your child find the next C to the right, then ask which sounds nicer.
classes.childAction: Move your thumb up to high C and play the same notes.
classes.bridge: Same hand shape, a new house to the right, high on the mountaintop.

intro.caption: Watch: same song, up high
intro.parentCue: Find the next two black keys to the right

games.caption: Climb the mountain, up high
games.parentCue: Sing it in a small, high voice

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: moving a song to a new place.

classes.title: Hike with the band
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music and keep going.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping your playing in time with the music

classes.parentPrompt: Nod on each big step together; if a note slips, keep going.
classes.childAction: Play with the music and keep going to the end.
classes.bridge: The music is the mountain path; keep walking and never stop.

intro.caption: Play along
intro.parentCue: Nod the big steps together as you play

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping in time with the music.

classes.title: Sing and climb
classes.goal: Sing the words while playing the tune, one word part for each note.

mathTarget.parentLine: Each sung word part matches one note on the keys

classes.parentPrompt: Sing first without playing, then sing louder so your child can lean on your voice.
classes.childAction: Sing 'the bear went over' while your fingers play it.
classes.bridge: Your voice and your fingers climb the mountain side by side.

intro.caption: Sing along first
intro.parentCue: Sing it once together before playing

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: matching words to notes.

classes.title: What did the bear see?
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy, then imagine what the bear could see.

mathTarget.parentLine: A song has a start, a middle and an end

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy in front; after the bow, ask: what did the bear see?
classes.childAction: Play for teddy, bow, then tell what the bear saw.
classes.bridge: The song climbs up, goes over the top, and lands home on C.

intro.caption: A song for teddy
intro.parentCue: Sit teddy in front and announce the song

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song, start to end.
